cohort: Women aged 20-35 years with singleton pregnancy between 22-32 weeks gestation, with abdominal circumference, estimated fetal weight below 10th percentile, or amniotic fluid index <= 7 cm
finding: Sildenafil citrate therapy was associated with significantly higher abdominal circumference growth, longer enrollment to delivery duration, and higher birth weight compared to no sildenafil treatment.
birth_weight: sildenafil group: 2040.92 g, control group: 1665.60 g
